headline: Championship run powers swing to profit
summary_short: Madison Square Garden Sports's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 36.7% y/y to $278.7M on record Knicks playoff and championship-related revenue, and diluted EPS swung to $1.16 from a $(0.07) loss a year ago.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 36.7% y/y to $278.7M (full year $1,153.8M, +11%), led by a $66.9M jump in playoff-related revenue as the Knicks won the NBA Championship, plus $7.2M higher league-distribution/national-media-rights revenue, partly offset by $3.5M lower local media-rights fees under amended MSG Networks agreements. Operating income swung to $32.2M from a $(22.6)M loss; adjusted operating income was $39.6M, both driven by the revenue gain against higher SG&A (+21% y/y, mostly playoff costs plus $2.9M of spin-off expenses). Diluted EPS was $1.16 versus $(0.07) a year ago. Cash rose to $164.5M; long-term debt held flat q/q at $242M; the stockholders' deficit narrowed to $(263.3)M. No financial guidance was issued; the Rangers spin-off is targeted for end of October 2026.
